notablePrerequisites:
Visara does not have summoning sickness.
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Xathrid Necromancer, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
